violation_type.title: Medication Records - Name of Child (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: A child is currently prescribed medication for daily use however, there was no documentation regarding who administers medication on file.

finding_variants.text: A child is currently prescribed medication for daily use however, there was no documentation regarding who administers medication on file.

Two medications in one classroom did not have the complete name of the child in which the medication belonged to. This was corrected at inspection as staff wrote the name of the children on the medication. In another room not used by children where medication is kept there was one medication that was not labeled with the child's name for whom the medication is for. All three medications did not have the date the medication was brought to the operation.
The operation did not document the name of the child that medication was administered to.
Medication records were checked for the HASA and found that the full name of the children listed was not being used.
The operation does not made medication administration records available for review during an inspection.
During inspection, staff who administered medication signed first name initial  and full last name.
